dream.text: Night folded into a single scene: at dusk four bodies moved together toward the western portal and its ring. The greeter opened palms to welcome, the pilgrim kept slow steady steps, the wanderer closed the arc, and the watcher held a wide sweep. Small routines—look, walk, wait—played until sleep; the hub’s New York night stitched the day into one gentle playout.
